title: The Whispering Woods
moral: True courage means choosing wisely and selflessly.

scenes.text: Sir Cedric enters the Whispering Woods to find his missing friend Elenora.
scenes.image_prompt: knight entering dark magical forest with glowing path

scenes.text: Cedric must solve riddles and face dangers while searching for the Heartstone.
scenes.image_prompt: knight facing river spirit asking riddle

scenes.summary: Cedric passes trials of wisdom and courage.
scenes.text: Cedric solves riddles and learns that not all battles require fighting.
scenes.image_prompt: knight calming magical beast instead of fighting

scenes.text: Cedric discovers his true identity and the prophecy tied to the Heartstone.
scenes.image_prompt: knight seeing magical vision in tower, glowing symbols

scenes.text: Cedric chooses to save others instead of seeking power, proving true courage.
scenes.image_prompt: knight standing bravely against dark shadow villain

story: Sir Cedric journeys into a magical forest to rescue his friend. He faces trials that test his wisdom and courage. In the end, he chooses selflessness over power and fulfills his destiny.
